Definition: from G5302; a falling short, i.e. (specially), penury:--want.
BiblicalUsage: hystérēsis means want, penury, need. In Mark 12:44, the text says "but she of her want did cast in all that she had."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hystérēsis as it stands: want, penury, need.
